title: Gallery of plates
when: Histories, comparisons across eras or styles, collections and catalogues: one subject seen many ways

voice.style: curious museum guide, warm and precise

rules: The film is a strip of framed plates on cream stock, travelled by one camera: open on the whole sheet, move plate to plate, close on the sheet again (the style-relay playbook).

Each plate is a different process: print presets (benday, engraving, newsprint, letterpress, halftone), mosaic styles (tesserae, pixel, stitch), material, rough. The subject stays the same so the change of process is the story.
Cross every border on a downbeat: plates are equal width, beats equal length, so the music's bar is the plate.
Label plates like a catalogue: number in accent serif italic, name in tracked caps, one italic line of date or place.
Between plates there is only paper and a thin rule; nothing floats in the gutters.
